sections.name: Verse 1
sections.sheet:
F#7  Bm              Em           D
        Was it going on behind my back?
F#7  Bm           Em                    D
        On second thought don't tell me that
F#7  Bm         Em                   D
        I don't need to know all the facts
               F#7   Bm  Em  D
I just need to know
sections.lyrics:
Was it going on behind my back?
On second thought don't tell me that
I don't need to know all the facts
I just need to know

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.sheet:
F#7  Bm            Em              D
        Is there a price for doing well?
F#7  Bm               Em                 D
        Should I feel bad 'cause I can't tell?
F#7  Bm        Em                 D
        I felt guilty there for a spell
                  F#7   Bm  Em  D
But now I need to know
sections.lyrics:
Is there a price for doing well?
Should I feel bad 'cause I can't tell?
I felt guilty there for a spell
But now I need to know

sections.name: Pre-chorus

A7                Em
  Am I wasting my time?

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.sheet:
F#7  Bm               Em         D
        Is there some trick to being happy?
F#7  Bm               Em           D
        Most days I'm feeling like a half me
F#7  Bm               Em        D
        And feel that life is moving past me
F#7  Bm        Em                        D
        I only told you 'cause you asked me
sections.lyrics:
Is there some trick to being happy?
Most days I'm feeling like a half me
And feel that life is moving past me
I only told you 'cause you asked me
